scout.label: underpriced path to profit
scout.thesis: Rivian trades near its 52-week low and below its $15.50 July offering, yet it has four straight quarters of positive consolidated gross profit, the exact gate for about $4.0B of DOE construction debt.
scout.watching_next: Q3 2026 results after close Thu 2026-10-29 (call 4:00 PM CT); Q3 10-Q due by 2026-11-09.
scout.help_or_hurt: Positive consolidated gross profit keeps the DOE loan gate open (helps); gross profit at or below zero breaks the streak and moves the name to RELEGATE.
scout.takeaway: The gate, not the car margin, is what to price.
bullets: FACT: Oct 29 gross profit above or below zero is a checkable binary.
OPINION: upside (Uber robotaxi, VW software) rides on the gate holding.
